{{Quote|We come for Jedi Master Ngani Zho|Unidentified Sith Knight|<ref name="Lost Suns 2" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]], a team of three [[Darth Mekhis' Sith Knights|Sith Knights]] was sent by [[Darth Mekhis]] to '''eliminate''' the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ngani Zho]]. The old Jedi escaped with the help of [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Theron Shan]] and [[Teff'ith]].<ref name="Lost Suns 2" />
